answer.reason: The verses name Merari only in genealogies and lists, and the tabernacle duties and cities they describe belong to his descendants, the sons of Merari, rather than to him.
doubts: NUM 3:36, NUM 4:31-33, NUM 7:8, NUM 10:17 and JOS 21:7 describe the charge, wagons and cities of the later Merarites, not of Merari himself, so they were not used.
Several marked verses (1CH 6:44, 1CH 15:6, 1CH 26:10, 2CH 29:12, 2CH 34:12, EZR 8:19) concern individual descendants of Merari, not Merari.
